# 🧪 QA Test Case Template

## Metadata
ID, title, area, priority, author, date, tested commit and browser/OS/device.

## Objective and preconditions
Describe expected behavior, board dimensions, player count, current turn and cell owner/count values.

## Steps
| Step | Action | Expected result |
|---|---|---|

## Expected final state
Include full board owner/count values, next player, input/animation state, terminal flag and winner.

## Actual result
Record behavior and evidence.

## Outcome
Pass / Fail / Blocked, linked defect and tester sign-off.
